purpose: Phase-8A immune-associated resistance CONTEXT. Phase-7C immune outputs (immune suppression / escape / checkpoint pressure / weak tumour visibility / exhausted adaptive response / low immune-mediated loss) MAY contribute a resistance context. IMPORTANT: Phase 7C (immune microenvironment) is NOT implemented in this frozen build, so there is no immune output to consume - every immune-associated input resolves to UNAVAILABLE and contributes NOTHING to resistance burden. No new immune biology is added and no immune-cell state is modified here; the resistance engine only ever consumes immutable Phase-7C outputs when they exist.

availability.note: When Phase 7C is added later, these inputs become consumable read-only; until then the immune-associated resistance state is UNAVAILABLE, not NOT_REPORTED-as-zero and not fabricated.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: each immune modifier in [0,1] (additive, bounded) - only usable once Phase 7C exists
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic immune-escape-associated protection the model would represent
coefficient_policy.source: Phase-7C immune outputs (read-only) - NOT AVAILABLE in this build
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: no contribution to burden while Phase 7C is absent.
coefficient_policy.limitations: Requires the Phase-7C immune-microenvironment layer, which is not implemented; no immune value is fabricated.

rules.no_new_immune_biology: The resistance engine never creates or modifies immune-cell states.
rules.no_duplication: Immune escape from Phase 7C (when present) is consumed once; it is never duplicated as a new immune-suppression mechanism inside Phase 8A.
rules.unavailable_not_zero: While Phase 7C is absent the state is UNAVAILABLE (distinct from a measured/predicted zero).
